scope: Instrumentation and tests only; no product source changed.
method: Paired speed:structural runs on flatblock under meter:flatblock, with identical product source in each pair. Compare all per-window totals, all canonical action/kind/field counters, every verdict, and every renamed reader key.
rule: Shared entity computeds are attributed to their entity field. Rows, derivations and distinct elements retain their existing counting and ratio rules. View-owned computeds retain consumer attribution. No expected-failure allowances changed.

negativeControls.sharedField: Actual @lazy field on an EntityModel subclass: one extra pool row call per item produces 1->4 and fails the ratio on the field key, even with a 1000-call constant reader beside it and a different first consumer.
negativeControls.viewField: Actual @lazy field on a view class named MeterViewModel: 1->4 row calls remain red under consumer:mission.pane/MeterViewModel@guard-seat.rowReads.
negativeControls.modelCoverage: All schema model classes, explicit field names, arbitrary computed names with entity context, an EntityModel subclass, cached second-view reads, nested view computeds, and a reader after an await.

knownReds: Both patched speed:structural runs retain the inherited sidebar.nested 10->12 and phone launch.usage 231->900 work-per-change reds, plus declared IssuePage elements 55->151 and 49->145. This is a successful instrument comparison, not a green structural lane.
evidence: POD-5778 artifacts: .review/census-key-changes.json contains every moved action/kind/reader counter and its before/after counts; four raw captures and resource records are in .review/structural-evidence.tar.gz.

leanGate.command: git checkout -- packages/api-types/src/index.d.ts; bun run test

scanCheck.command: bun scripts/check-interaction-scans.ts (executed by bun run test)

validation.suite: Only named structural files and the lean gate; no full suite or browser run.
